context.title: Conversation context
context.privacy: A private exchange between the parties to this request: it creates no personal connection and shows no read receipts.

state.closed: Conversation closed: its history remains readable.
state.unavailable: Conversation unavailable for now: its history remains readable.

voice.page: You are writing on behalf of the page: {{counterpart}} sees the page, never your name.
voice.facingPage: You are talking with the {{page}} team, which replies to you with a single voice.
voice.person: You are writing under your published name.

contextualConversation.loadError: The conversation could not be loaded.

errors.appRule: This message does not follow a rule of this request conversation. Edit it before sending.

messages.errorMessage: The messages of this conversation could not be loaded.

actions.title: Message actions
actions.removeConfirm: Remove this message for all parties? Its attachments are deleted with it.
actions.none: No action is possible on this message.

close.confirm: Close this conversation for good? The other party is notified. The subject of the request stays unchanged, and the conversation cannot be reopened.

calls.title: Calls in this conversation
calls.rule: A call requires both parties' consent in this conversation. Nothing rings automatically.
calls.consentPerson: By giving your consent, you agree to call and be called in this conversation only.
calls.consentPage: By giving your consent, you agree to call and be called in this conversation, and to be named in it: {{counterpart}} will see your name during the call.
calls.given: Your call consent is given for this conversation. You can withdraw it at any time.
calls.silentOverride: Your “outside my connections: silent” setting does not apply to this consent: it covers this conversation only.
calls.silentOverrideIfConsent: If you give your consent, your “outside my connections: silent” setting will not apply to this conversation.
calls.dndActive: “Do not disturb” is on until {{until}}: no call rings for you, including in this conversation.
calls.meetingSilence: Your automatic silence during meetings also applies to this conversation.
calls.callWaitingOff: You turned off the call-waiting signal: if you are already on a call, you show as busy, here too.
calls.incomingPushOff: You turned off ringing outside the tab: a call from this conversation only rings in an open tab.
calls.noTarget: Nobody on the team can be called right now.
calls.chooseTarget: Choose the team member to call.
calls.busy: A call is already in progress.
calls.callBackFromJournal: Call {{name}} back from the request conversation
calls.writeFromJournal: Write to {{name}} in the request conversation

list.title: Request conversations
list.scope: Search covers the request conversations already loaded.
list.empty: No request conversations yet. They open with a service request, accepted mentoring, shortlisted application or accepted professional collaboration.
list.errorMessage: The list of request conversations could not be loaded.
